NGO-001: NGO saves a partial registration (“Save draft and finish later”), leaves, returns to a prefilled form and submits; profile becomes PENDING with the draft's documents.
NGO-002: NGO submits registration documents; analysis runs and the profile moves PENDING → VERIFIED after admin approval.
NGO-003: NGO owner invites a Field Worker and a Program Manager; invite link accepted; reused/revoked links refused.
NGO-004: Project created with geography, budget and milestones; admin-approved; ACTIVE and matchable.
NGO-005: NGO match inbox lists the CSR invitation with its next action and a Respond link.
NGO-007: Change request → v2 submitted; revisions recorded; v2 selected for the contract.
NGO-008: After reconciliation every contract milestone shows FUNDED and the project is marked FUNDED (defect D4 fixed).
NGO-009: Field task assigned to a field worker by the owner/program manager.
NGO-010: Beneficiary feedback recorded with per-purpose consent (pseudonymous reference; consent honoured downstream).
NGO-011: Field worker logs in, lands on the Field app and sees only the tasks assigned to them.
NGO-012: Offline capture syncs with photo; replaying the same clientId returns the same record (no duplicate) (defect D2 fixed).
NGO-013: Normal photo with correct GPS uploads and persists; GPS check MATCH.
NGO-014: Duplicate / bad-GPS photo flagged → admin returns it → NGO recaptures and resubmits.
NGO-015: NGO records an expense against a contract milestone with a receipt; utilisation shown; donor sees it read-only.
NGO-016: Baseline 42% and endline 61% claims approved; NGO impact report shows +19 pp from approved claims only.
NGO-017: NGO creates and submits a stored impact report built from approved claims; admin publishes it; donor sees approved figures only.
NGO-018: NGO sees aggregated beneficiary feedback; the donor view shows aggregates only, with no personal data.
NGO-019: Grievance filed by the NGO and resolved through the admin workflow.
NGO-020: Donor renewal / next-opportunity request appears in /ngo/reporting; NGO accepts or declines.
DON-001: Donor registers, completes profile; organisation and PAN verified.
DON-002: Donor team invite with the Finance role; Finance can record payments but cannot approve proposals; Viewer cannot pay.
DON-003: Manual (form) CSR opportunity created, validated and entered into matching.
DON-004: RFP PDF uploaded; fields extracted with confidence; donor corrects a field (defect D3 fixed).
DON-005: Ranked, explainable shortlist (score, coverage, per-dimension reasons); FCRA variant excludes ineligible NGOs.
DON-006: Donor invites an approved NGO; NGO is notified and the proposal handoff follows.
DON-007: Change request on v1 reaches the NGO and produces v2.
DON-008: Donor compares proposal v1 and v2 side by side with highlighted changes, then selects v2.
DON-009: Contract signed by both parties and accepted by the NGO; ACTIVE.
DON-010: Payment lifecycle visible (pending → reconciled); UTR kept as the reference; remaining commitment shown (D4/D5 fixed).
DON-011: Donor sees contract, payment summary and correct per-milestone utilisation (all milestones FUNDED).
DON-012: Donor receives a milestone notification when a milestone is funded/completed.
DON-013: Donor impact dashboard and CSV show approved figures, the +19 pp change, and INSUFFICIENT_DATA where unbacked.
DON-014: Consent-safe donor story visible on the contract; non-consented material excluded.
DON-015: Donor feedback (HELPFUL + note) stored on an update.
DON-016: Donor “Renew this grant” from a stored impact report creates a re-engagement request (no 404).
DON-017: Donor pages and downloads show no beneficiary PII, risk scores or internal notes.
DON-018: Donor disables WhatsApp; notifications fall back to email/in-app and appear in the delivery log.
E2E-001: Sheet NGO profile verified end to end through the UI, including correcting a wrong document (D1 fixed).
E2E-002: Opportunity → match → admin-approved shortlist → invite → proposal; RFP upload path works.
E2E-003: v1 → change request → v2 → donor approval → contract; version history intact.
E2E-004: Contract → payment → reconciliation → allocation → milestones FUNDED.
E2E-005: Money → work → field evidence → admin approval → donor-safe update.
E2E-006: Evidence → approved outcome claims → +19 pp → donor impact report.
E2E-007: Grievance resolved, beneficiary and donor feedback stored, re-engagement started from the stored report.
E2E-008: Uninterrupted pilot journey through the UI from verification to re-engagement with no database manipulation.
